senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. preced.) to loosen, untie; (cmp. meaning of καταλύω) to take lodging; to rest, dwell.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 11a:5-7">Snh. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>יש … שראוי שתִּשְׁרֶה עליו שכינה</he> there is one among you who deserves that the Shechinah should rest upon him.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 65b:15">Ib.</cite> <he>שׁוֹרָה עליו וכ׳</he> the spirit … comes down upon him.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:6:5">Y. Sabb. VIII, end, 11ᶜ</cite> <he>רוח רעה שורה עליה</he> an evil spirit rests upon it (it is injurious to health).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:4">Num. R. s. 13<sup>2</sup></cite> <he>אימתי שָׁרְתָה וכ׳</he> when did the Shechinah come down to rest on earth? When the Tabernacle was erected.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:2:4">Koh. R. to VII, 2</cite> <he>ושָׁרַת עליהם  וכ׳</he> the holy spirit rested upon them.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 116:9">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVI</cite> <he>ומלאכי … ושׁוֹרִים ביניהם</he> (not <he>ושוררים</he>) the ministering angels rejoice over them (the righteous that die), that they come to dwell among them; ed. Bub. <he>שהוא בא ושורה וכ׳</he> that he (the righteous man) comes &c.; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="U01941"><he>שָׁרוּי</he></cite>; f. <he>שְׁרוּיָה</he>; pl. <he>שְׁרוּיִין</he>; <he>שְׁרוּיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 62b:19">Yeb. 62ᵇ</cite> he that has no wife, <he>ש׳ בלא שמחה וכ׳</he> lives without joy, without blessing &c.
<cite ref="Sotah 48a:7">Sot. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>בזמן שישראל ש׳ בצער וכ׳</he> when Israel lives in trouble, and the nations in peace and happiness &c.

<cite ref="Megillah 2a:23">Meg. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>בזמן שהשנים … ש׳ על אדמתן</he> when the years were properly regulated (without Roman interference), and the Israelites lived (undisturbed) on their soil; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Shabbat 139a:4">Sabb. 139ᵃ</cite> <he>אין הקב״ה מַשְׁרֶה וכ׳</he> the Lord does not let his Presence rest upon Israel, until the bad judges and officers cease to exist.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7a:17">Snh. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>כל דיין … משרה</he> a judge that administers true justice faithfully, causes the Shechinah to dwell in Israel.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 7">Gen. R. s. 7</cite> <he>מלך … ומשרה דיורין וכ׳</he> a human king builds a palace, and lets the inmates dwell in the upper and lower stories, <he>הק״בה משרה … בחלל</he> the Lord makes inmates dwell (even) in vacant space.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:4">Num. R. s. 13<sup>6</sup></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (cmp. שֵׁירוּתָא) to board, provide a living for.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:8">Keth. V, 8</cite> <he>המשרה את אשתו וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="U01335"><he>שָׁלִישׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 107a:11">Ib. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>כשה׳ לזו ולא ה׳ לזו</he> when he provided for the one (his wife), but did not provide for the others (his children); a. e.
